kevin: Quick kickoff for the authz postmortem follow-up. We noticed token validation failures + missing audit rows during last week's deploy window. Need owners and a lightweight remediation plan.
laura: I can own audit gaps and dashboarding. I'll add a panel that shows missing token_validation events by service.
mina: I'll take rotations and rollout verification. Plan to run a canary rotation in prod tomorrow 23:00 UTC with on-call.
oncall-bot: Alert suppressed: incident INC-2026-901 auto-mitigated; follow-up required.
kevin: Two recurring patterns: 1) env var rotations without pod drain -> cached tokens still used, 2) short emitter outage on logging side that drops audit entries.
laura: Query I'll use to detect gaps: ```SQL
SELECT service, date_trunc('minute', ts) AS minute, count(*) as cnt
FROM audit_logs
WHERE event = 'token_validation' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY service, minute
ORDER BY minute DESC;
```
mina: Rotation checklist (brief): - generate new key in KMS, - update k8s secret (kubectl patch), - rollout with rolling-update strategy, - validate no 5xx auth errors. I'll attach checklist to TASK-991.
secops: Creating TASK-991 in tracker for remediation sprint. Owners required: laura (audit/dashboard), mina (rotation+verify), kevin (blast-radius + postmortem doc). Deadlines suggested: laura 2026-04-08, mina 2026-04-09, kevin 2026-04-10.
laura: I want a metric for "audit_emitter_uptime" derived from logs. If uptime < 99.8% -> ticket. I'll PR infra-metrics.
mina: For the prod canary I'll run this curl to validate endpoint after rotation: 
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://auth.redwood.example/v1/validate | jq .status
```
kevin: Good. Also add a permanent smoke job that runs token validation across services post-deploy; weekly cadence at minimum. @laura please include this in dashboard and alerting.
laura: Will do. I've sketched a Grafana alert: expr = sum(rate(audit_log_miss_total[5m])) by (service) / sum(rate(audit_log_total[5m])) by (service) > 0.002 -> page. PR coming.
secops: TASK-991 created: tracker link http://tracker.internal/Task-991 (owner:laura,mina,kevin). Subtasks: 991-A audit-dashboard (owner:laura, due:2026-04-08), 991-B rotation-canary (owner:mina, due:2026-04-09), 991-C smoke-job (owner:kevin, due:2026-04-10).
kevin: Let's include retrospective notes: how many times in last 6 months? laura, can you pull frequency and add to the postmortem doc?
laura: I'll add counts and a short timeline. Preliminary: 3 incidents with similar trace (rotations + missing emitter) since Nov.
mina: I'll schedule the canary with on-call and post the runbook link when done.
kevin: OK reconvene Fri @ 11:00 to verify tasks and close any blockers. If rotation hits problems, escalate to secops immediately. :eyes:
